name: REVEREND SOWERBY
note: Reverend Sowerby (doc 01: 'presides over funerals with enormous feeling... Charges by the adjective'). In Room 4 he presides over the Assay: errata 75 -- 'The judges sit in the dark beyond the lamp; Sowerby holds the pencil' -- and reads the handbill's five rules before each duel (doc 03). His drawing is room-04's fifth operation (Tyler, 2026-11-01: the fourth had a chair in front of his leg, which no cut could recover): the room edited to flat magenta around him and Thad, with him redrawn whole, keyed by tools/art/room04-sowerby.py. He stands at the foot of the back wall in the judges' shadow, between the front chair and the table's left end, at the room's curve (437 at his soles, y 513: the annotation's `beyond` sample). Present while the Assay sits: from B3 until Thad walks out after Duel Two is won (T_ASSAY_ADJOURNED, written by the door), so he never sees them vanish. His id is his speaker id, so his lines are drawn over his head. No tree in this room; every verb is doc 07's people pool.
walkToNote: On the floor in front of him, at the band's back edge, facing him.
barksNote: Doc 07 writes no barks for Sowerby in Room 4.

sprite.note: Frames: 0 rest · 1 breath · 2 pencil hand lowered · 3 lowered further · 4 raised · 5 leaning toward the judges · 6 leaning back, all derived from his rest frame by tools/rig/room04-idles.py (the forearm turned about the elbow). Breathing on 0 and 1 at `rate`; every `breakEvery` seconds one break from the pool -- most of them the pencil marking the air (errata 35: deliberate movement; Tyler, 2026-11-01: 'Sowerby's arm needs to move up and down otherwise it looks like he's frozen').

props.note: THE JUDGES' PENCIL, IN HIS HAND. The plate paints the pencil on the table for the room without him; while he is present he holds it (errata 75), and this piece of the plate's own bare table -- the wood beside the pencil, matched row by row -- covers the one on the table. Drawn only while he is, because a prop is his.

sprite.frameNote: 0 rest, the pencil raised · 1 breath (derived) · 2 the pencil lowered to his chest · 3 leaning to confer · 4 leaning back, the pencil up. Breathing on 0 and 1; every `breakEvery` seconds one break (errata 77).
sprite.redrawn: Errata 111 (Tyler, 2026-11-06): drawn from the locked cast master, cast-unify operation 20 (reference/cast-unify-18.txt); cut with its own pixels and a clean edge; its own file (the room scripts write the old one).
sprite.figureHeightNote: Crown to sole of the rest frame; the room's man where he stands is 437, as he was drawn.

sprite.depthYNote: The floor row of the depth he stands at: the pulpit's platform at the back of the church, behind the pulpit's front (its base meets the floor near y 600). The room's depth curve, carried back to here, makes a man about 285 px; he is drawn at a man's waist-up for that (tools/art/room17-sowerby-scale.py). Tyler, 2026-11-08: "he looks enormous behind the podium" -- he was the waist-up of a man of nearly 500.
sprite.frameNote: 0 rest, hands on the reading desk · 1 breath (derived) · 2 preaching, a finger raised · 3 counting adjectives on his fingers · 4 a hand on his heart. A break every `breakEvery` seconds (errata 77). He preaches as he talks.
sprite.redrawn: Errata 111 (Tyler, 2026-11-06): drawn from the locked cast master, cast-unify operation 20 (reference/cast-unify-18.txt); cut with its own pixels and a clean edge; its own file (the room scripts write the old one). At the pulpit, cut at the waist with his hands on the pulpit's top either side of the reading desk; the drawing brought a reading desk of its own, and every pixel of the figure where the room's desk (plane 1) stands in front of him is cleared, so the sheet carries none.

plateFurniture.note: The pulpit's reading desk and top are the PLATE's (errata 112 R): his frames draw nothing there but his hands (tools/art/room17-sowerby-desk.py). Each pose of the sheet had drawn its own desk, so the book-rest jumped when he gestured.

placementsNote: CHURCH (Room 17, errata 90 B): at his pulpit, his own church sheet (drawn against Room 4's), and his tree, SOWERBY; not there on the funeral day -- 'Sowerby is not there. He is up the hill.' (doc 57 C3).
